parameters.sink: temporary regular file on data filesystem, never a pipe
parameters.log_window: entire server lifecycle including seed, warmup, verification and shutdown
parameters.recent_counter_window: entire server lifecycle through post-load snapshot, including warmup
parameters.reader_schedule: one process; both endpoints/cycle; skip missed ticks; no catch-up bursts
parameters.listener_policy: one reserved loopback port reused across fresh server lifecycles; new TCP/request
